description.short: Answers you privately in Teams, saves what you choose, and proposes knowledge where capture is on.
description.full: Ask Aerugo in a 1:1 chat with it, or mention it in a channel: it answers you privately, in your 1:1 chat, with only what you may read. Choose Save to Aerugo on a message to propose it to your team's curators: your own anywhere, someone else's where capture is on. Aerugo reads this team's standard channels once its owner adds the app, each post readable only by the team's members; a channel is captured only when its team's admin in Aerugo confirms it, and the bot then posts a notice there. Anyone in the team can choose Don't capture on a message to keep it out. Private and shared channels and group chats are never read. In a meeting its organizer adds it to, the organizer can write "@Aerugo capture on": Aerugo then keeps the meeting's transcripts, readable only by the people in its chat, and proposes decisions, lessons, and facts for them to confirm; anyone in the meeting can write "@Aerugo don't capture" to end it and remove what it kept.
